t: You're on Castelnau, a road in Barnes, in the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames. It's about five miles west of Charing Cross, on the south side of the river. Charles Stewart Drewry, a British mechanical engineer, died here in 1929, at the age of eighty-five or eighty-six. He was born in 1843, so his life spans much of the Victorian age and the early twentieth century, and it ended on this Barnes road.
